_doc: BACKLOG §M phase 3: the heuristic agents' answer to a SkillUse offer, read VERBATIM by both engines (Rust SkillPolicy, Java SkillPolicy; the CLI exports FFB_SKILL_POLICY). use = weight of USING the skill when offered, in thousandths (softmax T=0.20 over use vs 1000-use); hand-set by game value. coverage = how strongly --coverage-bias B pulls it toward use: w + (B*coverage/1000)*(1-w); GENERATED from an offer census by scripts/skill_policy_coverage.py. Keys are Java class simple names (edition spellings differ: SideStep/Sidestep). DumpOff with no in-range receiver is pinned to 0 in code in both agents.
